name: Introduction to Database Systems
description: Understanding the core concepts of databases and DBMS, the 3-level ANSI-SPARC architecture (External, Conceptual, Internal), and the importance of data independence.

name: Entity-Relationship Diagram (ERD)
description: Conceptual data modeling using ERD, covering entities, attributes, relationships, cardinality (1:1, 1:N, M:N), and generalization/specialization hierarchies.

name: Relational Model & Mapping ERD
description: Mapping conceptual ERD into a relational schema, understanding Primary Key, Foreign Key, referential integrity, and table relationship types.

name: Database Normalization (1NF, 2NF, 3NF, BCNF)
description: Analyzing functional dependencies and decomposing tables to eliminate data anomalies (insertion, update, deletion) and achieve normal forms.

name: SQL Data Definition Language (DDL)
description: Writing SQL queries to define database schemas using CREATE TABLE, ALTER TABLE, DROP, and adding constraints (PRIMARY KEY, FOREIGN KEY, UNIQUE, CHECK).

name: Basic SQL Data Manipulation Language (DML)
description: Manipulating data using basic SELECT queries, INSERT, UPDATE, and DELETE operations on a single table, including WHERE clause filtering.

name: SQL Joins & Subqueries
description: Combining multiple tables using INNER JOIN, LEFT/RIGHT JOIN, FULL OUTER JOIN, and formulating nested subqueries for complex data retrieval.

name: SQL Aggregation & Grouping
description: Using aggregate functions (SUM, AVG, COUNT, MAX, MIN) combined with GROUP BY and HAVING clauses for data analysis and reporting.

name: Transaction & Concurrency Control
description: Understanding ACID transaction properties, concurrency interference problems (dirty read, non-repeatable read, phantom read), and the Two-Phase Locking (2PL) mechanism.

name: Indexing & Query Optimization
description: Creating indexes (B-Tree, Hash) to accelerate data retrieval and reading Execution Plans to identify and optimize slow queries.
